verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י הַגּוֹרָ֗ל לְמַטֵּ֛ה בְּנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם אֶל־ גְּב֨וּל אֱד֧וֹם מִדְבַּר־ צִ֛ן נֶ֖גְבָּה מִקְצֵ֥ה תֵימָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî hag·gō·w·rāl lə·maṭ·ṭêh bə·nê yə·hū·ḏāh lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām ’el- gə·ḇūl ’ĕ·ḏō·wm miḏ·bar- ṣin neḡ·bāh miq·ṣêh ṯê·mān
verses.literal: Now the allotment for the clans of the tribe of Judah extended to the border of Edom to the Wilderness of Zin at the extreme southern boundary
verses.literalPt: A SORTE que coube à tribo dos filhos de Judá, segundo as suas famílias, foi até ao termo de Edom, o deserto de Zim, para o sul, na extremidade do lado meridional.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֤י לָהֶם֙ גְּב֣וּל נֶ֔גֶב מִקְצֵ֖ה יָ֣ם הַמֶּ֑לַח מִן־ הַלָּשֹׁ֖ן הַפֹּנֶ֥ה נֶֽגְבָּה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî lā·hem gə·ḇūl ne·ḡeḇ miq·ṣêh yām ham·me·laḥ min- hal·lā·šōn hap·pō·neh neḡ·bāh
verses.literal: Their southern border started at the bay . . . on the southern tip of the Salt Sea . . .
verses.literalPt: E foi o seu termo para o sul, desde a extremidade do Mar Salgado, desde a baía que olha para o sul;

verses.original: וְ֠יָצָא אֶל־ מִנֶּ֜גֶב לְמַעֲלֵ֤ה עַקְרַבִּים֙ וְעָ֣בַר צִ֔נָה וְעָלָ֥ה מִנֶּ֖גֶב לְקָדֵ֣שׁ בַּרְנֵ֑עַ וְעָבַ֤ר חֶצְרוֹן֙ וְעָלָ֣ה אַדָּ֔רָה וְנָסַ֖ב הַקַּרְקָֽעָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·ṣā ’el- min·ne·ḡeḇ lə·ma·‘ă·lêh ‘aq·rab·bîm wə·‘ā·ḇar ṣi·nāh wə·‘ā·lāh min·ne·ḡeḇ lə·qā·ḏêš bar·nê·a‘ wə·‘ā·ḇar ḥeṣ·rō·wn wə·‘ā·lāh ’ad·dā·rāh wə·nā·saḇ haq·qar·qā·‘āh
verses.literal: proceeded . . . south of the Ascent of Akrabbim continued on to Zin went over to the south . . . of Kadesh-barnea ran past Hezron up to Addar and curved toward Karka
verses.literalPt: E sai para o sul, até à subida de Acrabim, e passa a Zim, e sobe do sul a Cades-Barnéia, e passa por Hezrom, e sobe a Adar, e vira para Carca;

verses.original: וְעָבַ֣ר עַצְמ֗וֹנָה וְיָצָא֙ נַ֣חַל מִצְרַ֔יִם וְהָיָה תֹּצְא֥וֹת הַגְּב֖וּל יָ֑מָּה זֶה־ יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם גְּב֥וּל נֶֽגֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·ḇar ‘aṣ·mō·w·nāh wə·yā·ṣā na·ḥal miṣ·ra·yim wə·hå̄·yå̄h tō·ṣə·’ō·wṯ hag·gə·ḇūl yām·māh zeh- yih·yeh lā·ḵem gə·ḇūl ne·ḡeḇ
verses.literal: It proceeded to Azmon . . . joined the Brook of Egypt and ended . . . at the Sea This was their southern border
verses.literalPt: E passa Azmom, e sai ao ribeiro do Egito, e as saídas deste termo vão até ao mar; este será o vosso termo do lado do sul.

verses.original: וּגְב֥וּל קֵ֙דְמָה֙ יָ֣ם הַמֶּ֔לַח עַד־ קְצֵ֖ה הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן וּגְב֞וּל לִפְאַ֤ת צָפ֙וֹנָה֙ מִלְּשׁ֣וֹן הַיָּ֔ם מִקְצֵ֖ה הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḡə·ḇūl qê·ḏə·māh yām ham·me·laḥ ‘aḏ- qə·ṣêh hay·yar·dên ū·ḡə·ḇūl lip̄·’aṯ ṣā·p̄ō·w·nāh mil·lə·šō·wn hay·yām miq·ṣêh hay·yar·dên
verses.literal: The eastern border was the Salt Sea . . . as far as the mouth of the Jordan The northern border started from the bay of the sea at the mouth of the Jordan
verses.literalPt: O termo, porém, para o oriente será o Mar Salgado, até à foz do Jordão; e o termo para o norte será da baía do mar, desde a foz do Jordão.

verses.original: וְעָלָ֤ה הַגְּבוּל֙ בֵּ֣ית חָגְלָ֔ה וְעָבַ֕ר מִצְּפ֖וֹן לְבֵ֣ית הָעֲרָבָ֑ה וְעָלָ֣ה הַגְּב֔וּל אֶ֥בֶן בֹּ֖הַן בֶּן־ רְאוּבֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·lāh hag·gə·ḇūl bêṯ ḥā·ḡə·lāh wə·‘ā·ḇar miṣ·ṣə·p̄ō·wn lə·ḇêṯ hā·‘ă·rā·ḇāh wə·‘ā·lāh hag·gə·ḇūl ’e·ḇen bō·han ben- rə·’ū·ḇên
verses.literal: went up to Beth-hoglah proceeded north of Beth-arabah and went up . . . to the Stone of Bohan son of Reuben
verses.literalPt: E este termo subirá até Bete-Hogla, e passará do norte a Bete-Arabá, e este termo subirá até à pedra de Boã, filho de Rúben.

verses.original: וְעָלָ֨ה הַגְּב֥וּל׀ דְּבִרָה֮ מֵעֵ֣מֶק עָכוֹר֒ וְצָפ֜וֹנָה פֹּנֶ֣ה אֶל־ הַגִּלְגָּ֗ל אֲשֶׁר־ נֹ֙כַח֙ לְמַעֲלֵ֣ה אֲדֻמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִנֶּ֖גֶב לַנָּ֑חַל וְעָבַ֤ר הַגְּבוּל֙ אֶל־ מֵי־ עֵ֣ין שֶׁ֔מֶשׁ וְהָי֥וּ תֹצְאֹתָ֖יו אֶל־ עֵ֥ין רֹגֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·lāh hag·gə·ḇūl də·ḇi·rāh mê·‘ê·meq ‘ā·ḵō·wr wə·ṣā·p̄ō·w·nāh pō·neh ’el- hag·gil·gāl ’ă·šer- nō·ḵaḥ lə·ma·‘ă·lêh ’ă·ḏum·mîm ’ă·šer min·ne·ḡeḇ lan·nā·ḥal wə·‘ā·ḇar hag·gə·ḇūl ’el- mê- ‘ên še·meš wə·hā·yū ṯō·ṣə·’ō·ṯāw ’el- ‘ên rō·ḡêl
verses.literal: Then the border went up to Debir from the Valley of Achor turning north to Gilgal which faces the Ascent of Adummim south of the ravine It continued along the waters of En-shemesh and came out . . . at En-rogel
verses.literalPt: Subirá mais este termo a Debir desde o vale de Acor, indo para o norte rumo a Gilgal, a qual está em frente da subida de Adumim, que está para o sul do ribeiro; então este termo continua até às águas de En-Semes; e as suas saídas estão do lado de En-Rogel.

verses.original: וְעָלָ֨ה הַגְּב֜וּל גֵּ֣י בֶן־ הִנֹּ֗ם אֶל־ כֶּ֤תֶף הַיְבוּסִי֙ מִנֶּ֔גֶב הִ֖יא יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְעָלָ֨ה הַגְּב֜וּל אֶל־ רֹ֣אשׁ הָהָ֗ר אֲ֠שֶׁר עַל־ פְּנֵ֤י גֵֽי־ הִנֹּם֙ יָ֔מָּה אֲשֶׁ֛ר בִּקְצֵ֥ה עֵֽמֶק־ רְפָאִ֖ים צָפֹֽנָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·lāh hag·gə·ḇūl gê ḇen- hin·nōm ’el- ke·ṯep̄ hay·ḇū·sî min·ne·ḡeḇ hî yə·rū·šā·lim wə·‘ā·lāh hag·gə·ḇūl ’el- rōš hā·hār ’ă·šer ‘al- pə·nê ḡê- hin·nōm yām·māh ’ă·šer biq·ṣêh ‘ê·meq- rə·p̄ā·’îm ṣā·p̄ō·nāh
verses.literal: From there the border went up the Valley of Ben-hinnom . . . . . . along the southern slope of the Jebusites (that is Jerusalem and ascended . . . to the top of the hill that faces . . . the Valley of Hinnom . . . on the west at the northern end of the Valley of Rephaim
verses.literalPt: E este termo sobe pelo vale do filho de Hinom, do lado sul dos jebuseus (esta é Jerusalém) e sobe este termo até ao cume do monte que está diante do vale de Hinom para o ocidente, que está no fim do vale dos refains do lado do norte.

verses.original: וְתָאַ֨ר הַגְּב֜וּל מֵרֹ֣אשׁ הָהָ֗ר אֶל־ מַעְיַן֙ מֵ֣י נֶפְתּ֔וֹחַ וְיָצָ֖א אֶל־ עָרֵ֣י הַר־ עֶפְר֑וֹן וְתָאַ֤ר הַגְּבוּל֙ בַּעֲלָ֔ה הִ֖יא קִרְיַ֥ת יְעָרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṯā·’ar hag·gə·ḇūl mê·rōš hā·hār ’el- ma‘·yan mê nep̄·tō·w·aḥ wə·yā·ṣā ’el- ‘ā·rê har- ‘ep̄·rō·wn wə·ṯā·’ar hag·gə·ḇūl ba·‘ă·lāh hî qir·yaṯ yə·‘ā·rîm
verses.literal: From the hilltop . . . the border curved to the spring of the Waters of Nephtoah proceeded to the cities of Mount Ephron and then bent around . . . toward Baalah (that is Kiriath-jearim)
verses.literalPt: Então este termo vai desde a altura do monte até à fonte das águas de Neftoa; e sai até às cidades do monte de Efrom; vai mais este termo até Baalá (esta é Quiriate-Jearim).

verses.original: וְנָסַב֩ הַגְּב֨וּל מִבַּעֲלָ֥ה יָ֙מָּה֙ אֶל־ הַ֣ר שֵׂעִ֔יר וְעָבַ֕ר אֶל־ כֶּ֧תֶף הַר־ יְעָרִ֛ים מִצָּפ֖וֹנָה הִ֣יא כְסָל֑וֹן וְיָרַ֥ד בֵּֽית־ שֶׁ֖מֶשׁ וְעָבַ֥ר תִּמְנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·saḇ hag·gə·ḇūl mib·ba·‘ă·lāh yām·māh ’el- har śê·‘îr wə·‘ā·ḇar ’el- ke·ṯep̄ har- yə·‘ā·rîm miṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·w·nāh hî ḵə·sā·lō·wn wə·yā·raḏ bêṯ- še·meš wə·‘ā·ḇar tim·nāh
verses.literal: The border curled westward from Baalah to Mount Seir ran along the northern slope of Mount Jearim (that is Chesalon went down to Beth-shemesh and crossed to Timnah
verses.literalPt: Então volta este termo desde Baalá para o ocidente, até às montanhas de Seir, e passa ao lado do monte de Jearim do lado do norte (esta é Quesalom) e desce a Bete-Semes, e passa por Timna;

verses.original: וְיָצָ֨א הַגְּב֜וּל אֶל־ כֶּ֣תֶף עֶקְרוֹן֮ צָפוֹנָה֒ וְתָאַ֤ר הַגְּבוּל֙ שִׁכְּר֔וֹנָה וְעָבַ֥ר הַר־ הַֽבַּעֲלָ֖ה וְיָצָ֣א יַבְנְאֵ֑ל וְהָי֛וּ תֹּצְא֥וֹת הַגְּב֖וּל יָֽמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·ṣā hag·gə·ḇūl ’el- ke·ṯep̄ ‘eq·rō·wn ṣā·p̄ō·w·nāh wə·ṯā·’ar hag·gə·ḇūl šik·kə·rō·w·nāh wə·‘ā·ḇar har- hab·ba·‘ă·lāh wə·yā·ṣā yaḇ·nə·’êl wə·hā·yū tō·ṣə·’ō·wṯ hag·gə·ḇūl yām·māh
verses.literal: Then it went out to the northern slope of Ekron curved . . . toward Shikkeron proceeded to Mount Baalah went on to Jabneel and ended . . . . . . at the Sea
verses.literalPt: Sai este termo mais ao lado de Ecrom, para o norte, e este termo vai a Sicrom e passa o monte de Baalá, e sai em Jabneel; e assim este termo finda no mar.

verses.original: וּגְב֣וּל יָ֔ם הַיָּ֥מָּה הַגָּד֖וֹל וּגְב֑וּל זֶ֠ה גְּב֧וּל בְּנֵֽי־ יְהוּדָ֛ה סָבִ֖יב לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḡə·ḇūl yām hay·yām·māh hag·gā·ḏō·wl ū·ḡə·ḇūl zeh gə·ḇūl bə·nê- yə·hū·ḏāh sā·ḇîḇ lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām
verses.literal: And the western border was the coastline of the Great Sea These are the boundaries around the clans of the descendants of Judah
verses.literalPt: Será, porém, o termo do lado do ocidente o Mar Grande, e suas adjacências; este é o termo dos filhos de Judá ao redor, segundo as suas famílias.

verses.original: וּלְכָלֵ֣ב בֶּן־ יְפֻנֶּ֗ה נָ֤תַן חֵ֙לֶק֙ בְּת֣וֹךְ בְּנֵֽי־ יְהוּדָ֔ה אֶל־ פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לִֽיהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ אֶת־ קִרְיַ֥ת אַרְבַּ֛ע אֲבִ֥י הָעֲנָ֖ק הִ֥יא חֶבְרֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·ḵā·lêḇ ben- yə·p̄un·neh nā·ṯan ḥê·leq bə·ṯō·wḵ bə·nê- yə·hū·ḏāh ’el- pî Yah·weh lî·hō·wō·šu·a‘ ’eṯ- qir·yaṯ ’ar·ba‘ ’ă·ḇî hā·‘ă·nāq hî ḥeḇ·rō·wn
verses.literal: According to the LORD’s command to him Joshua gave Caleb son of Jephunneh a portion among the sons of Judah Kiriath-arba that is Hebron Arba was the forefather of Anak
verses.literalPt: Mas a Calebe, filho de Jefoné, deu uma parte no meio dos filhos de Judá, conforme a ordem do SENHOR a Josué; a saber, a cidade de Arba, que é Hebrom; este Arba era pai de Anaque.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤רֶשׁ מִשָּׁם֙ כָּלֵ֔ב אֶת־ שְׁלוֹשָׁ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י הָעֲנָ֑ק אֶת־ שֵׁשַׁ֤י וְאֶת־ אֲחִימַן֙ וְאֶת־ תַּלְמַ֔י יְלִידֵ֖י הָעֲנָֽק׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·reš miš·šām kā·lêḇ ’eṯ- šə·lō·wō·šāh bə·nê hā·‘ă·nāq ’eṯ- šê·šay wə·’eṯ- ’ă·ḥî·man wə·’eṯ- tal·may yə·lî·ḏê hā·‘ă·nāq
verses.literal: And Caleb drove out from there the three sons of Anak the descendants of Sheshai Ahiman and Talmai the children of Anak
verses.literalPt: E Calebe expulsou dali os três filhos de Anaque; Sesai, e Aimã, e Talmai, gerados de Anaque.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַל מִשָּׁ֔ם אֶל־ יֹשְׁבֵ֖י דְּבִ֑ר וְשֵׁם־ דְּבִ֥ר לְפָנִ֖ים קִרְיַת־ סֵֽפֶר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘al miš·šām ’el- yō·šə·ḇê də·ḇir wə·šêm- də·ḇir lə·p̄ā·nîm qir·yaṯ- sê·p̄er
verses.literal: From there he marched against the inhabitants of Debir formerly known as Kiriath-sepher
verses.literalPt: E dali subiu aos habitantes de Debir; e fora antes o nome de Debir, Quiriate-Sefer.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר כָּלֵ֔ב אֲשֶׁר־ יַכֶּ֥ה אֶת־ קִרְיַת־ סֵ֖פֶר וּלְכָדָ֑הּ וְנָתַ֥תִּי ל֛וֹ אֶת־ עַכְסָ֥ה בִתִּ֖י לְאִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer kā·lêḇ ’ă·šer- yak·keh ’eṯ- qir·yaṯ- sê·p̄er ū·lə·ḵā·ḏāh wə·nā·ṯat·tî lōw ’eṯ- ‘aḵ·sāh ḇit·tî lə·’iš·šāh
verses.literal: And Caleb said To the man who strikes down Kiriath-sepher and captures it I will give my daughter Acsah in marriage
verses.literalPt: E disse Calebe: Quem ferir a Quiriate-Sefer, e a tomar, lhe darei a minha filha Acsa por mulher.

verses.original: וַֽיִּלְכְּדָ֛הּ עָתְנִיאֵ֥ל בֶּן־ קְנַ֖ז אֲחִ֣י כָלֵ֑ב וַיִּתֶּן־ ל֛וֹ אֶת־ עַכְסָ֥ה בִתּ֖וֹ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yil·kə·ḏāh ‘ā·ṯə·nî·’êl ben- qə·naz ’ă·ḥî ḵā·lêḇ way·yit·ten- lōw ’eṯ- ‘aḵ·sāh ḇit·tōw lə·’iš·šāh
verses.literal: So Othniel son of Caleb’s brother Kenaz captured the city and Caleb gave his daughter Acsah to him in marriage
verses.literalPt: Tomou-a, pois, Otniel, filho de Quenaz, irmão de Calebe; e deu-lhe a sua filha Acsa por mulher.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י בְּבוֹאָ֗הּ וַתְּסִיתֵ֙הוּ֙ לִשְׁא֤וֹל מֵֽאֵת־ אָבִ֙יהָ֙ שָׂדֶ֔ה וַתִּצְנַ֖ח מֵעַ֣ל הַחֲמ֑וֹר וַיֹּֽאמֶר־ לָ֥הּ כָּלֵ֖ב מַה־ לָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî bə·ḇō·w·’āh wat·tə·sî·ṯê·hū liš·’ō·wl mê·’êṯ- ’ā·ḇî·hā śā·ḏeh wat·tiṣ·naḥ mê·‘al ha·ḥă·mō·wr way·yō·mer- lāh kā·lêḇ mah- lāḵ
verses.literal: One day Acsah came to Othniel and urged him to ask her father for a field When she got off . . . her donkey Caleb asked her What do you desire
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que, vindo ela a ele, o persuadiu que pedisse um campo a seu pai; e ela desceu do seu jumento; então Calebe lhe disse: Que é que tens?

verses.original: וַתֹּ֜אמֶר תְּנָה־ לִּ֣י בְרָכָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֶ֤רֶץ הַנֶּ֙גֶב֙ נְתַתָּ֔נִי וְנָתַתָּ֥ה לִ֖י גֻּלֹּ֣ת מָ֑יִם וַיִּתֶּן־ לָ֗הּ אֵ֚ת גֻּלֹּ֣ת עִלִּיּ֔וֹת וְאֵ֖ת גֻּלֹּ֥ת תַּחְתִּיּֽוֹת׃פ
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer tə·nāh- lî ḇə·rā·ḵāh kî ’e·reṣ han·ne·ḡeḇ nə·ṯat·tā·nî wə·nā·ṯat·tāh lî gul·lōṯ mā·yim way·yit·ten- lāh ’êṯ gul·lōṯ ‘il·lî·yō·wṯ wə·’êṯ gul·lōṯ taḥ·tî·yō·wṯ
verses.literal: Give me a blessing she answered Since you have given me land in the Negev give me springs of water as well So Caleb gave her both the upper - and lower springs
verses.literalPt: E ela disse: Dá-me uma bênção; pois me deste terra seca, dá-me também fontes de águas. Então lhe deu as fontes superiores e as fontes inferiores.

verses.original: זֹ֗את נַחֲלַ֛ת מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵי־ יְהוּדָ֖ה לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: zōṯ na·ḥă·laṯ maṭ·ṭêh ḇə·nê- yə·hū·ḏāh lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām
verses.literal: This is the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Judah
verses.literalPt: Esta é a herança da tribo dos filhos de Judá, segundo as suas famílias.

verses.original: וַיִּֽהְי֣וּ הֶעָרִ֗ים מִקְצֵה֙ לְמַטֵּ֣ה בְנֵֽי־ יְהוּדָ֔ה אֶל־ גְּב֥וּל אֱד֖וֹם בַּנֶּ֑גְבָּה קַבְצְאֵ֥ל וְעֵ֖דֶר וְיָגֽוּר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yih·yū he·‘ā·rîm miq·ṣêh lə·maṭ·ṭêh ḇə·nê- yə·hū·ḏāh ’el- gə·ḇūl ’ĕ·ḏō·wm ban·neḡ·bāh qaḇ·ṣə·’êl wə·‘ê·ḏer wə·yā·ḡūr
verses.literal: These were the southernmost cities of the tribe of Judah in the Negev toward the border of Edom Kabzeel Eder Jagur
verses.literalPt: São, pois, as cidades da tribo dos filhos de Judá, até ao termo de Edom, no extremo sul: Cabzeel, e Eder, e Jagur.

verses.original: וְקִינָ֥ה וְדִֽימוֹנָ֖ה וְעַדְעָדָֽה׃
verses.literal: Kinah Dimonah Adadah
verses.literalPt: E Quiná, e Dimona, e Adada,

verses.original: וְקֶ֥דֶשׁ וְחָצ֖וֹר וְיִתְנָֽן׃
verses.literal: Kedesh Hazor Ithnan
verses.literalPt: E Quedes, e Hazor, e Itnã,

verses.original: זִ֥יף וָטֶ֖לֶם וּבְעָלֽוֹת׃
verses.literal: Ziph Telem Bealoth
verses.literalPt: Zife, e Telem, e Bealote,

verses.original: וְחָצ֤וֹר׀ חֲדַתָּה֙ וּקְרִיּ֔וֹת חֶצְר֖וֹן הִ֥יא חָצֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥā·ṣō·wr ḥă·ḏat·tāh ū·qə·rî·yō·wṯ ḥeṣ·rō·wn hî ḥā·ṣō·wr
verses.literal: Hazor-hadattah Kerioth-hezron . . . (that is Hazor
verses.literalPt: E Hazor-Hadata, e Queriote-Hezrom (que é Hazor),

verses.original: אֲמָ֥ם וּשְׁמַ֖ע וּמוֹלָדָֽה׃
verses.literal: Amam Shema Moladah
verses.literalPt: Amã e Sema, e Moladá,

verses.original: וַחֲצַ֥ר גַּדָּ֛ה וְחֶשְׁמ֖וֹן וּבֵ֥ית פָּֽלֶט׃
verses.literal: Hazar-gaddah Heshmon Beth-pelet
verses.literalPt: E Hazar-Gada, e Hesmom, e Bete-Palete,

verses.original: וַחֲצַ֥ר שׁוּעָ֛ל וּבְאֵ֥ר שֶׁ֖בַע וּבִזְיוֹתְיָֽה׃
verses.literal: Hazar-shual Beersheba Biziothiah
verses.literalPt: E Hazar-Sual, e Berseba, e Biziotiá,

verses.original: בַּעֲלָ֥ה וְעִיִּ֖ים וָעָֽצֶם׃
verses.literal: Baalah Iim Ezem
verses.literalPt: Baalá, e Iim, e Azem,

verses.original: וְאֶלְתּוֹלַ֥ד וּכְסִ֖יל וְחָרְמָֽה׃
verses.literal: Eltolad Chesil Hormah
verses.literalPt: E Eltolade, e Quesil, e Hormá.

verses.original: וְצִֽקְלַ֥ג וּמַדְמַנָּ֖ה וְסַנְסַנָּֽה׃
verses.literal: Ziklag Madmannah Sansannah
verses.literalPt: E Ziclague, e Madmana, e Sansana,

verses.original: וּלְבָא֥וֹת וְשִׁלְחִ֖ים וְעַ֣יִן וְרִמּ֑וֹן כָּל־ עָרִ֛ים עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וָתֵ֖שַׁע וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ wə·šil·ḥîm wə·‘a·yin wə·rim·mō·wn kāl- ‘ā·rîm ‘eś·rîm wā·ṯê·ša‘ wə·ḥaṣ·rê·hen
verses.literal: Lebaoth Shilhim Ain and Rimmon twenty-nine . . . cities in all along with their villages
verses.literalPt: E Lebaote, e Silim, e Aim, e Rimom; todas as cidades e as suas aldeias, vinte e nove.

verses.original: בַּשְּׁפֵלָ֑ה אֶשְׁתָּא֥וֹל וְצָרְעָ֖ה וְאַשְׁנָֽה׃
verses.literal: These were in the foothills Eshtaol Zorah Ashnah
verses.literalPt: Nas planícies: Estaol, e Zorá, e Asná,

verses.original: וְזָנ֙וֹחַ֙ וְעֵ֣ין גַּנִּ֔ים תַּפּ֖וּחַ וְהָעֵינָֽם׃
verses.literal: Zanoah En-gannim Tappuah Enam
verses.literalPt: E Zanoa, e En-Ganim, Tapua, e Enã.

verses.original: יַרְמוּת֙ וַעֲדֻלָּ֔ם שׂוֹכֹ֖ה וַעֲזֵקָֽה׃
verses.literal: Jarmuth Adullam Socoh Azekah
verses.literalPt: E Jarmute, e Adulão, Socó, e Azeca,

verses.original: וְשַׁעֲרַ֙יִם֙ וַעֲדִיתַ֔יִם וְהַגְּדֵרָ֖ה וּגְדֵרֹתָ֑יִם עָרִ֥ים אַרְבַּֽע־ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃
verses.literal: Shaaraim Adithaim and Gederah (or Gederothaim) fourteen . . . cities along with their villages
verses.literalPt: E Saaraim, e Aditaim, e Gederá, e Gederotaim; catorze cidades e as suas aldeias.

verses.original: צְנָ֥ן וַחֲדָשָׁ֖ה וּמִגְדַּל־ גָּֽד׃
verses.literal: Zenan Hadashah Migdal-gad
verses.literalPt: Zenã, e Hadasa, e Migdal-Gade,

verses.original: וְדִלְעָ֥ן וְהַמִּצְפֶּ֖ה וְיָקְתְאֵֽל׃
verses.literal: Dilan Mizpeh Joktheel
verses.literalPt: E Dileã, e Mizpe, e Jocteel,

verses.original: לָכִ֥ישׁ וּבָצְקַ֖ת וְעֶגְלֽוֹן׃
verses.literal: Lachish Bozkath Eglon
verses.literalPt: Laquis, e Bozcate, e Eglom,

verses.original: וְכַבּ֥וֹן וְלַחְמָ֖ס וְכִתְלִֽישׁ׃
verses.literal: Cabbon Lahmas Chitlish
verses.literalPt: E Cabom, e Laamás, e Quitlis,

verses.original: וּגְדֵר֕וֹת בֵּית־ דָּג֥וֹן וְנַעֲמָ֖ה וּמַקֵּדָ֑ה עָרִ֥ים שֵׁשׁ־ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·ḡə·ḏê·rō·wṯ bêṯ- dā·ḡō·wn wə·na·‘ă·māh ū·maq·qê·ḏāh ‘ā·rîm šêš- ‘eś·rêh wə·ḥaṣ·rê·hen
verses.literal: Gederoth Beth-dagon Naamah and Makkedah sixteen . . . cities along with their villages
verses.literalPt: E Gederote, Bete-Dagom, e Naamá, e Maqueda, dezesseis cidades e as suas aldeias.

verses.original: לִבְנָ֥ה וָעֶ֖תֶר וְעָשָֽׁן׃
verses.literal: Libnah Ether Ashan
verses.literalPt: Libna, e Eter, e Asã,

verses.original: וְיִפְתָּ֥ח וְאַשְׁנָ֖ה וּנְצִֽיב׃
verses.literal: Iphtah Ashnah Nezib
verses.literalPt: E Iftá, e Asná, e Nezibe,

verses.original: וּקְעִילָ֥ה וְאַכְזִ֖יב וּמָֽרֵאשָׁ֑ה עָרִ֥ים תֵּ֖שַׁע וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃
verses.literal: Keilah Achzib and Mareshah nine cities along with their villages
verses.literalPt: E Queila, e Aczibe, e Maressa; nove cidades e as suas aldeias.

verses.original: עֶקְר֥וֹן וּבְנֹתֶ֖יהָ וַחֲצֵרֶֽיהָ׃
verses.literal: Ekron with its towns and villages
verses.literalPt: Ecrom, com suas vilas, e as suas aldeias.

verses.original: מֵעֶקְר֖וֹן וָיָ֑מָּה כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ עַל־ יַ֥ד אַשְׁדּ֖וֹד וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃
verses.literal: from Ekron to the sea all the cities near . . . Ashdod along with their villages
verses.literalPt: Desde Ecrom, e até ao mar, todas as que estão do lado de Asdode, e as suas aldeias.

verses.original: אַשְׁדּ֞וֹד בְּנוֹתֶ֣יהָ וַחֲצֵרֶ֗יהָ עַזָּ֥ה בְּנוֹתֶ֥יהָ וַחֲצֵרֶ֖יהָ עַד־ נַ֣חַל מִצְרָ֑יִם וְהַיָּ֥ם הַגָּבוֹל וּגְבֽוּל׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’aš·dō·wḏ bə·nō·w·ṯe·hā wa·ḥă·ṣê·re·hā ‘az·zāh bə·nō·w·ṯe·hā wa·ḥă·ṣê·re·hā ‘aḏ- na·ḥal miṣ·rā·yim wə·hay·yām hag·gå̄·ḇōl ū·ḡə·ḇūl
verses.literal: Ashdod with its towns and villages Gaza with its towns and villages as far as the Brook of Egypt and the coastline of the Great Sea
verses.literalPt: Asdode, com as suas vilas e as suas aldeias; Gaza, com as suas vilas e as suas aldeias, até ao rio do Egito, e o Mar Grande e o seu termo.

verses.original: וּבָהָ֑ר שָׁמִ֥יר וְיַתִּ֖יר וְשׂוֹכֹֽה׃
verses.literal: These were in the hill country Shamir Jattir Socoh
verses.literalPt: E nas montanhas: Samir, Jatir, e Socó.

verses.original: וְדַנָּ֥ה וְקִרְיַת־ סַנָּ֖ה הִ֥יא דְבִֽר׃
verses.literal: Dannah Kiriath-sannah (that is Debir
verses.literalPt: E Daná, e Quiriate-Saná (que é Debir),

verses.original: וַעֲנָ֥ב וְאֶשְׁתְּמֹ֖ה וְעָנִֽים׃
verses.literal: Anab Eshtemoh Anim
verses.literalPt: E Anabe, Estemó, e Anim,

verses.original: וְגֹ֥שֶׁן וְחֹלֹ֖ן וְגִלֹ֑ה עָרִ֥ים אַֽחַת־ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃
verses.literal: Goshen Holon and Giloh eleven . . . cities along with their villages
verses.literalPt: E Gósen, e Holom, e Giló; onze cidades e as suas aldeias.

verses.original: אֲרַ֥ב וְרוּמָ֖ה וְאֶשְׁעָֽן׃
verses.literal: Arab Dumah Eshan
verses.literalPt: Arabe, e Dumá e Esã,

verses.original: וְיָנִים וּבֵית־ תַּפּ֖וּחַ וַאֲפֵֽקָה׃
verses.literal: Janim Beth-tappuah Aphekah
verses.literalPt: E Janim, e Bete-Tapua e Afeca,

verses.original: וְחֻמְטָ֗ה וְקִרְיַ֥ת אַרְבַּ֛ע הִ֥יא חֶבְר֖וֹן וְצִיעֹ֑ר עָרִ֥ים תֵּ֖שַׁע וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥum·ṭāh wə·qir·yaṯ ’ar·ba‘ hî ḥeḇ·rō·wn wə·ṣî·‘ōr ‘ā·rîm tê·ša‘ wə·ḥaṣ·rê·hen
verses.literal: Humtah Kiriath-arba (that is Hebron and Zior nine cities along with their villages
verses.literalPt: E Hunta, e Quiriate-Arba (que é Hebrom), e Zior; nove cidades e as suas aldeias.

verses.original: מָע֥וֹן׀ כַּרְמֶ֖ל וָזִ֥יף וְיוּטָּֽה׃
verses.literal: Maon Carmel Ziph Juttah
verses.literalPt: Maom, Carmelo, e Zife, e Jutá,

verses.original: וְיִזְרְעֶ֥אל וְיָקְדְעָ֖ם וְזָנֽוֹחַ׃
verses.literal: Jezreel Jokdeam Zanoah
verses.literalPt: E Jizreel, e Jocdeão, e Zanoa,

verses.original: הַקַּ֖יִן גִּבְעָ֣ה וְתִמְנָ֑ה עָרִ֥ים עֶ֖שֶׂר וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃
verses.literal: Kain Gibeah and Timnah ten cities along with their villages
verses.literalPt: Caim, Gibeá, e Timna; dez cidades e as suas aldeias.

verses.original: חַלְח֥וּל בֵּֽית־ צ֖וּר וּגְדֽוֹר׃
verses.literal: Halhul Beth-zur Gedor
verses.literalPt: Halul, Bete-Zur, e Gedor,

verses.original: וּמַעֲרָ֥ת וּבֵית־ עֲנ֖וֹת וְאֶלְתְּקֹ֑ן עָרִ֥ים שֵׁ֖שׁ וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃
verses.literal: Maarath Beth-anoth and Eltekon six cities along with their villages
verses.literalPt: E Maarate, e Bete-Anote, e Eltecom; seis cidades e as suas aldeias.

verses.original: קִרְיַת־ בַּ֗עַל הִ֛יא קִרְיַ֥ת יְעָרִ֖ים וְהָֽרַבָּ֑ה עָרִ֥ים שְׁתַּ֖יִם וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: qir·yaṯ- ba·‘al hî qir·yaṯ yə·‘ā·rîm wə·hā·rab·bāh ‘ā·rîm šə·ta·yim wə·ḥaṣ·rê·hen
verses.literal: Kiriath-baal (that is Kiriath-jearim and Rabbah two cities along with their villages
verses.literalPt: Quiriate-Baal (que é Quiriate-Jearim), e Rabá; duas cidades e as suas aldeias.

verses.original: בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר בֵּ֚ית הָעֲרָבָ֔ה מִדִּ֖ין וּסְכָכָֽה׃
verses.literal: These were in the wilderness Beth-arabah Middin Secacah
verses.literalPt: No deserto: Bete-Arabá, Midim, e Secacá,

verses.original: וְהַנִּבְשָׁ֥ן וְעִיר־ הַמֶּ֖לַח וְעֵ֣ין גֶּ֑דִי עָרִ֥ים שֵׁ֖שׁ וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·han·niḇ·šān wə·‘îr- ham·me·laḥ wə·‘ên ge·ḏî ‘ā·rîm šêš wə·ḥaṣ·rê·hen
verses.literal: Nibshan the City of Salt and En-gedi six cities along with their villages
verses.literalPt: E Nibsã, e a Cidade do Sal, e En-Gedi; seis cidades e as suas aldeias.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הַיְבוּסִי֙ יוֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרֽוּשָׁלִַ֔ם לֹֽא־ יוּכְלוּ בְנֵֽי־ יְהוּדָ֖ה לְהֽוֹרִישָׁ֑ם וַיֵּ֨שֶׁב הַיְבוּסִ֜י אֶת־ בְּנֵ֤י יְהוּדָה֙ בִּיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- hay·ḇū·sî yō·wō·šə·ḇê yə·rū·šā·lim lō- yū·ḵə·lū ḇə·nê- yə·hū·ḏāh lə·hō·w·rî·šām way·yê·šeḇ hay·ḇū·sî ’eṯ- bə·nê yə·hū·ḏāh bî·rū·šā·lim ‘aḏ hay·yō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: But the descendants of Judah could not drive out the Jebusites living in Jerusalem So to this day the Jebusites live there among the descendants of Judah
verses.literalPt: Não puderam, porém, os filhos de Judá expulsar os jebuseus que habitavam em Jerusalém; assim habitaram os jebuseus com os filhos de Judá em Jerusalém, até ao dia de hoje.
